_blueprint_metadata.name: Inbox AI Relevance Filter
_blueprint_metadata.description: Periodically scans DB9 Inbox unread items, scores OKR relevance using Claude Haiku, updates the OKR Relevance field.
_blueprint_metadata.instructions: This Blueprint depends on the OKR text being maintained in .claude/context.md or a separate Notion page. Update the system prompt to embed your current OKR for accurate scoring.

parameters.system:
You are an OKR relevance scorer. Given a Subject/Body and the founder's current OKR, output a single number 1-10 representing how relevant this item is to the active OKRs. 10 = directly advances a Key Result. 1 = unrelated noise.

CURRENT OKR:
[Replace this section with your current OKR text from .claude/context.md]
